description: D450: confirmation of the current selection plan, not authentication or cryptographic evidence of a human gesture. Auth and visibility remain authoritative. No challenge persistence.

compatibility.scope: Only consumo marked sin_garantia=true and guarantee_mode=false, or eligible informative igual with payments disabled.
compatibility.legacy: No field or only confirm_closure:true can save a non-completing selection; a completing mutation is rejected before all business writes.
compatibility.success: Existing 200 bodies and GET/capability envelopes unchanged. Equal exact replay remains read-only, even with an outdated well-formed confirmation.
compatibility.errors: 400 for malformed field; existing permission, availability and terminal errors win. required/changed return 409, private,no-store and Vary:Authorization. changed has a challenge only while the valid current plan still closes.
compatibility.client: Never auto-confirm or retry. Freeze operation and challenge together; state_changed requires a fresh explicit human action. Old tabs can remain and receive 409. Voluntary update policy unchanged.

revision.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with recursively sorted object keys. Row arrays ordered by item UUID, then claim UUID/user UUID; requests and projection ordered by item UUID. UUIDs lowercase. Integer DB bigint fields are exact decimal strings; SQL integer fields remain numbers; null remains null.
bindings: live claims id/item/user/bps/status/payment_attempt_id/attempt_status/expiry/created_at/paid_at/expired_at_tx OR all informative item/user/bps/created_at/updated_at
canonical requested fractions including denominator when provided
projected coverage and amounts in bps only
revision.timestamps: UTC strings from PostgreSQL with six decimal places (microseconds), never JS Date truncation. Claim expiration semantics use transaction NOW(), with server clock_timestamp() enforcing the acceptance deadline after lock waits and in the closing UPDATE.
revision.valid_until: Minimum of mesa expires_at and non-expired-at-transaction locked claim deadlines; null locks add no deadline. No arbitrary TTL or extension.
revision.not_a_history_counter: Semantically identical state gives an identical digest. Release/reacquire IDs and informative write timestamps normally invalidate. No vector/claim IDs/actor/lock tokens returned or logged.
